C1270.title: SSO Identity Account Inconsistency Vulnerability Leading to Account Takeover
C1270.summary: Research found that SSO systems heavily depend on email addresses to bind identity while overlooking that email addresses can be reused. Attackers can obtain recycled email addresses and use SSO authentication flows to take over original users associated online accounts without passwords, affecting many tested popular websites. The issue shows platforms should verify email ownership changes and third-party login binding status.
